verdict.rationale: Freshsales is a SaaS CRM, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only a REST API with per-user API keys, which is a developer building block rather than an MCP server. Nothing in the pack mentions MCP, and the probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs, or OpenAPI spec on the developer site.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
